mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in sustained monetary easing.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% triggers fiscal stimulus and central bank intervention, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as market anticipates policy support for weak labor conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5, or Rank IC over 2-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in retail sales (RSAFS) signals consumer spending reallocation toward consumption, preceding positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as economic recovery gains momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST declines and RSAFS rises, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production exceeding 100 indicates robust manufacturing expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days during industrial expansion cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls exceeding 100,000 jobs per month strengthen consumer spending power, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as labor market conditions support economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price index exceeding 215 signals accelerating inflation, prompting expectations of monetary tightening that drives negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 215, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate decline and CPIAUCSL rise indicate central bank stimulus during inflation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as market prices growth support.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales exceeding 350,000 million dollars signals strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as demand supports corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 350000, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.
